scope: For every natural n, exact equivalence with B union {15,48} union {m R_t: m in B and R_t prime}; R_t=(10^t-1)/9. Both directions proved without any bound on n or t.

statement_audit.composite_exclusion: Divisor quotients are inherited only from the original parent; no false hereditary-predicate premise.
statement_audit.converse: Prime-product divisor split, divisor closure of B, decimal digit induction and all small exceptions.
